marketSummary: The Nifty 50 gained 53 points (+0.23%) to close at 23,270.60, while India VIX dropped 7.82% to 12.14, signalling volatility compression after the US Federal Reserve delivered an expected 25 bps rate hike. Domestic Institutional Investors provided strong liquidity support with net inflows of ₹3,908 crore against FII net sales of ₹2,032 crore. Sectoral leadership was led by Nifty Pharma (+1.66%), Nifty Realty (+1.45%), and a technical bounce in the Nifty India Defence index (+1.30%) following a five-session pullback.
dailyFocus: Track base consolidation and volume expansion across large-cap Defence names (BEL, HAL) post fresh contract awards, alongside Pharma breakouts led by commercial product approvals. Watch Tata group counters following board decisions on the Tata Sons listing roadmap.

news.headline: Bharat Electronics Secures ₹648 Crore Defence Orders for IR Jammers and AI Solutions
news.summary: Navratna defence PSU Bharat Electronics announced under SEBI LODR Regulation 30 that it has secured additional orders worth ₹648 crore since August 26, 2026. The contracts encompass laser-based IR jammers, advanced communication equipment, AI-based software solutions, and transmitter-receiver modules, fortifying its standalone order backlog past ₹72,250 crore.
news.impact: Triggers fresh volume interest near ₹390-₹395 support, reinforcing odds of a base-breakout continuation toward previous swing highs.

news.headline: Tata Sons Board Clears Listing Roadmap and Reappoints Chairman N Chandrasekaran
news.summary: Tata Sons' board resolved by majority vote to approve a five-year term extension for Executive Chairman N Chandrasekaran until 2032 and cleared the company's mandatory listing roadmap, despite dissent recorded by Tata Trusts Chairman Noel Tata. The decision sparked buying across core Tata Group equities.
news.impact: Eases holding-level leadership overhang across Tata Group tickers, helping Trent defend its critical ₹2,700-₹2,730 support pocket.

news.headline: NSE Opens ₹22,562 Crore Public Issue with Anchor Allocation of ₹6,250 Crore
news.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India opened its landmark ₹22,561.57 crore IPO for subscription from September 17 to September 21, 2026, in a price band of ₹1,700-₹1,785 per share via 100% OFS. The anchor book closed at over ₹6,250 crore with institutional participation, including a ₹450 crore allocation to LIC, while tentative BSE listing is scheduled for September 24.
news.impact: Heightens liquidity rotation into capital market proxies and exchange-linked financials while anchoring broad market risk appetite.

news.headline: Hindustan Aeronautics Bounces 1.5% as MoD Procurement Drive Counters Execution Lags
news.summary: Hindustan Aeronautics shares gained 1.5% to ₹4,940 on September 17, participating in a broader defence pullback. Sentiment was bolstered by the Defence Acquisition Council's ₹1.10 lakh crore Acceptance of Necessity sanction and progress on GE Aerospace F404 engine shipments supporting the Tejas Mk1A programme.
news.impact: Stock confirms an undercut-and-rally off the ₹4,800 demand line; clearing ₹5,050 resistance opens room for a base completion setup.

news.headline: Alkem Laboratories Launches Novel Anti-Seizure Drug NeuCeno in India
news.summary: Alkem Laboratories rolled out NeuCeno (cenobamate) across India for the management of partial-onset seizures in adults. Cenobamate is introduced for the first time domestically, with trial data indicating up to a 78% reduction in seizure frequency and 30% seizure freedom in maintenance phases.
news.impact: Drives momentum breakout in Alkem (+3.35%) and pulls peers higher, confirming pharmaceutical sector leadership.

news.headline: India VIX Slumps 7.8% to 12.14 as US Fed Delivers 25 bps Hike with Moderate Stance
news.summary: NSE India VIX dropped 7.82% to 12.14 on September 17 after the US Federal Reserve raised the target policy rate by 25 bps to 3.75%-4.00%. The Nifty 50 absorbed initial volatility to settle above 23,270, underpinned by persistent domestic mutual fund net purchases of ₹3,908 crore.
news.impact: Volatility crush reduces option premiums and creates a stable tape for multi-day swing breakout follow-throughs above 23,300.

news.headline: Nifty India Defence Index Gains 1.3% Snapping Five-Day Losing Streak
news.summary: The Nifty India Defence index rebounded 1.30% to 9,248 on September 17, reversing a cumulative five-day drop of 8.69%. The rebound saw broad accumulation across Paras Defence (+4.5%), Data Patterns (+4.2%), BEML (+3.6%), and Bharat Electronics (+2.0%), reflecting institutional dip-buying at structural support.
news.impact: Halts aggressive distribution across Tier-1 defence charts, enabling swing traders to look for right-side base development.

news.headline: CG Power Rallies 3.5% Towards 50-DMA Ahead of Institutional Meet on September 25
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions jumped 3.48% intraday to touch ₹883.45 on heavy turnover, outperforming benchmark capital goods peers. In an exchange disclosure under SEBI LODR Regulation 30, the company scheduled a one-on-one institutional investor meet organised by IIFL Institutional Equities for September 25, 2026.
news.impact: Approaching key resistance near ₹900; institutional interaction scheduled for September 25 could determine the breakout follow-through.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Stabilises Ahead of September 18 Ex-Dividend Cut-Off
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard held above ₹1,480 on September 17, the final day for investors under the T+1 settlement regime to secure eligibility for the company's ₹1.50 per share dividend (record date: Friday, September 18, 2026). The counter saw bottom-fishing after falling over 11% in the prior 30 sessions.
news.impact: Ex-dividend price adjustment on September 18 will test whether the ₹1,450-₹1,475 shelf can serve as the launchpad for a multi-week cup pattern.

news.headline: Union Cabinet Raises Mandatory EPFO Wage Ceiling to ₹25,000 Per Month
news.summary: The Union Cabinet approved increasing the statutory wage ceiling for mandatory Employees' Provident Fund Organisation coverage from ₹15,000 to ₹25,000 per month, effective September 17, 2026. The reform brings over 51 lakh formal sector workers into statutory retirement and insurance coverage.
news.impact: Long-term institutional tailwind for domestic contractual savings and retirement fund inflows into Indian equities, though immediate trading impact is muted.
